Name: Custom Greenhouse Warps
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Allows the player to set a custom greenhouse warp location on the farm map, as well as fixes the interior warps for custom greenhouses.
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Custom greenhouses have always had the issue of their warps dropping you in the wrong location.  Previously, it was impossible to fix this without a mod such as MTN or editing the warp on the farm map and replacing the entire map.  Now, you can fix the warps with any farm map, thanks to Content Patcher supporting map edits!

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Custom Greenhouse Warps' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once using SMAPI to generate the config file.

5.  Access the config file from the mod folder and choose your settings.  Options will be listed below, as well as in the readme.
Config Options

*   UseCustomMapPositionOn - Choose which farm map you need to use a custom position for.  Allows multiple choices, defaults to "none":

1.  Standard

2.  Forest

3.  Riverland

4.  Hilltop

5.  Wilderness

6.  FourCorners

7.  none

*   CustomMapPositionX - the "X" coordinate for the custom position you want to use.  Allows any integer between 0 and 255.  You can ignore this option if you are using "none" in the first option.

*   CustomMapPositionY - the "Y" coordinate for the custom position you want to use.  Allows any integer between 0 and 255.  You can ignore this option if you are using "none" in the first option.
